from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u019/system/state/workspace')
programs=root/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    points={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg}
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for p in points:
        if p in seen: continue
        q=[p]; seen.add(p); comp=[]
        while q:
            r,c=q.pop(); comp.append((r,c))
            for n in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if n in points and n not in seen:
                    seen.add(n); q.append(n)
        comps.append(comp)
    templates=[c for c in comps if len(c)>1]
    if not templates: return g
    template=max(templates,key=len)
    r0=min(r for r,c in template); r1=max(r for r,c in template)
    c0=min(c for r,c in template); c1=max(c for r,c in template)
    ar=(r0+r1)//2; ac=(c0+c1)//2
    shape=[(r-ar,c-ac,g[r][c]) for r,c in template]
    targets=[p[0] for p in comps if len(p)==1]
    for r,c in targets:
        for dr,dc,color in shape:
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: g[rr][cc]=color
    return g
'''
